title: 板壁直立平衡
description: 透明水彩呈现低角度板壁上直立的身体与两只清晰脚点。

art_direction.medium: clean cel-shaded sports animation with crisp anatomy and soft environmental light
art_direction.scene: Create an original transparent watercolor illustration of a fictional fully clothed adult standing upright on a gently leaning slab wall. Two broad low footholds support a balanced stance, and one palm rests on a generous handhold at shoulder level. The climber looks toward a nearby next foothold while keeping the torso aligned over the feet. Use a three-quarter wide view that makes the slab angle, entire body, and thick continuous crash mats easy to read. Soft green wall washes, pale peach holds, and window-light reflections create a quiet gym atmosphere. Preserve credible shoe contact and adult proportions. No jumping, extreme flexibility, lettering, logos, or exposed outdoor climbing.
